lab_meta <- list(id = "lab09", title = "Review Exercises")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "On a hold-out, which metric is scale-dependent (same units as the data)?",

## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Graphics + ACF + accuracy
```{r review-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=16}
library(fpp3)
aus_production |> autoplot(Beer)
aus_production |> gg_season(Beer)
aus_production |> ACF(Beer) |> autoplot()
train <- aus_production |> filter_index(. ~ "2008 Q4")
fit <- train |>
  model(
    snaive = SNAIVE(Beer),
    ses = ETS(Beer ~ error("A") + trend("N") + season("N"))
  )
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = 8)
fc |> accuracy(aus_production)
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("RMSE / MAE", correct = TRUE),
  answer("MAPE only"),
  answer("AICc only"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Seasonal naïve (SNAIVE)", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Mean of all history with no season"),
  answer("White-noise forecast of 0"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "1) graphics 2) ACF 3) …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

Answer the questions above first, type your name, download the `.txt`, and upload it.

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
